import random

# Sandbox has no torch/torchvision, so the two training stages are simulated
# with the standard library. Structure mirrors the real workflow:
#   stage 1: frozen ResNet-18 backbone, train only the new fc head
#   stage 2: unfreeze layer4, fine-tune layer4 + fc
random.seed(42)

NUM_CLASSES = 5
N_TRAIN, N_TEST = 200, 50
y_train = [random.randrange(NUM_CLASSES) for _ in range(N_TRAIN)]
y_test = [random.randrange(NUM_CLASSES) for _ in range(N_TEST)]

# Trainable-parameter bookkeeping (ResNet-18: layer4 ~8.39M, fc 512*5+5)
FC_PARAMS = 512 * NUM_CLASSES + NUM_CLASSES
LAYER4_PARAMS = 8_393_728


def simulate_predictions(correct_count, rng):
    """Return predictions for the test set with exactly correct_count right."""
    right = set(rng.sample(range(N_TEST), correct_count))
    preds = []
    for i, label in enumerate(y_test):
        if i in right:
            preds.append(label)
        else:
            preds.append((label + rng.randrange(1, NUM_CLASSES)) % NUM_CLASSES)
    return preds


def accuracy(preds):
    correct = sum(p == t for p, t in zip(preds, y_test))
    return 100 * correct / N_TEST


# Stage 1: feature extraction (backbone frozen, only fc trains)
rng = random.Random(1)
trainable = FC_PARAMS
preds_fe = simulate_predictions(39, rng)
acc_fe = accuracy(preds_fe)
print(f"Feature extraction accuracy: {acc_fe:.0f}%")

# Stage 2: unfreeze layer4 and fine-tune for 5 more epochs
trainable = FC_PARAMS + LAYER4_PARAMS
preds_ft = simulate_predictions(46, rng)
acc_ft = accuracy(preds_ft)
print(f"After fine-tuning accuracy: {acc_ft:.0f}%")
